title: 해상풍력 보급 촉진 및 산업 육성에 관한 특별법 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment ( Infrastructure Support Team ), 044-201-7764

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Special Act on the Promotion of Offshore Wind Power Supply and Industry Development and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Special Act on the Promotion of Offshore Wind Power Supply and Industry Development and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Application for Designation as Offshore Wind Power Agency) ① Any person who intends to be designated as an offshore wind power agency pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Promotion of Offshore Wind Power Supply and Industry Development (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”)an application for designation as an offshore wind power agency in the form of Annex No. 1, attaching documents proving that the designation criteria of each subparagraph of Paragraph 2 of the same article have been met.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Application for Designation as Offshore Wind Power Agency) ① Any person who intends to be designated as an offshore wind power agency pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Promotion of Offshore Wind Power Supply and Industry Development (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall submit an application for designation as an offshore wind power agency in the form of Annex No. 1, attaching documents proving that the designation criteria of each subparagraph of Paragraph 2 of the same Article have been met.

rows.source_ko: ② Upon receiving an application under Paragraph 1, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall verify the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the documents under Subparagraph 2, the applicant shall be required to attach such documents.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application under Paragraph 1, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall verify the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the documents under Subparagraph 2, the applicant shall be required to attach such documents.

rows.source_ko: 1. Certificate of Corporate Registration
rows.text_en: 1. Certificate of Corporate Registration

rows.source_ko: 2. Business Registration Certificate
rows.text_en: 2. Business Registration Certificate

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Contents of the Impact Report on Marine and Environmental Aspects) ① The “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Contents of the Impact Report on Marine and Environmental Aspects) ① The “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Overview of the Basic Design Proposal
rows.text_en: 1. Overview of the Basic Design Proposal

rows.source_ko: 2. Characteristics of the marine environment in the basic design area
rows.text_en: 2. Characteristics of the marine environment in the basic design area

rows.source_ko: 3. Impact on marine space use resulting from the installation of offshore wind power facilities and the execution of offshore wind power projects, and countermeasures therefor
rows.text_en: 3. Impact on marine space use resulting from the installation of offshore wind power facilities and the execution of offshore wind power projects, and countermeasures therefor

rows.source_ko: ② The “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: ② The “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Overview of the Basic Design Proposal
rows.text_en: 1. Overview of the Basic Design Proposal

rows.source_ko: 2. Characteristics of the Natural and Living Environments of the Basic Design Target Area
rows.text_en: 2. Characteristics of the Natural and Living Environments of the Basic Design Target Area

rows.source_ko: 3. Impact on space utilization due to power grid interconnection and countermeasures
rows.text_en: 3. Impact on space utilization due to power grid interconnection and countermeasures

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Request for Mediation of Disputes Concerning Matters Consulted by the Public-Private Council) Any Special City Mayor, Metropolitan City Mayor, Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Provincial Governor, Special Self-Governing Provincial Governor, or Mayor, County Head, or District Head (referring to the head of a self-governing district) who intends to request mediation of a dispute concerning matters under each subparagraph of Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Special Act on the Promotion of Offshore Wind Power Supply and Industry (hereinafterreferred to as the “Act”) pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit the application for mediation of disputes concerning matters consulted by the Public-Private Council in the form of Annex 2 to the Offshore Wind Power Generation Committee pursuant to Article 6 , Paragraph 1 of the Act .
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Request for Mediation of Disputes Concerning Matters Consulted by the Public-Private Council) Any Special City Mayor, Metropolitan City Mayor, Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Provincial Governor, Special Self-Governing Provincial Governor, or Mayor, County Head, or District Head (referring to the head of a self-governing district) who intends to request mediation of a dispute concerning matters under each subparagraph of Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Special Act on the Promotion of Offshore Wind Power Supply and Industry Development (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit the application for mediation of disputes concerning matters consulted by the Public-Private Council in the form of Annex 2 to the Offshore Wind Power Generation Committee pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Application for Selection of Offshore Wind Power Business Operator) ①person who intends to be selected as an offshore wind power business operator pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment an application for selection of an offshore wind power business operator in the form of Annex 3 , attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Application for Selection of Offshore Wind Power Business Operator) ① A person who intends to be selected as an offshore wind power business operator pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment an application for selection of an offshore wind power business operator in the form of Annex 3, attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Offshore Wind Power Project Plan
rows.text_en: 1. Offshore Wind Power Project Plan

rows.source_ko: 2. Documents proving financial soundness and fundraising ability
rows.text_en: 2. Documents proving financial soundness and fundraising ability

rows.source_ko: ② Upon receiving an application under Paragraph 1, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall verify the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the documents under Subparagraphs 2 through 4, the applicant shall be required to attach such documents.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application under Paragraph 1, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall verify the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the documents under Subparagraphs 2 through 4, the applicant shall be required to attach such documents.

rows.source_ko: 1. Certificate of Corporate Registration (applicable only to corporations)
rows.text_en: 1. Certificate of Corporate Registration (applicable only to corporations)

rows.source_ko: 2. Business Registration Certificate
rows.text_en: 2. Business Registration Certificate

rows.source_ko: 3. Copy of the representative's resident registration certificate
rows.text_en: 3. Copy of the representative's resident registration certificate

rows.source_ko: 4. Certificate of National and Local Tax Payment
rows.text_en: 4. Certificate of National and Local Tax Payment

rows.source_ko: ③ When the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment selects an offshore wind power business operator pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall issue an Offshore Wind Power Business Operator Selection Certificate in the form of Annex 4 .
rows.text_en: ③ When the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment selects an offshore wind power business operator pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall issue an Offshore Wind Power Business Operator Selection Certificate in the form of Annex 4 .

rows.source_ko: 제6조(실시계획 승인 신청 등) ① 영 제19조제2항에 따른 실시계획의 승인 또는 변경승인을 받으려는 해상풍력발전사업자는 별지 제5호서식의 해상풍력발전사업 실시계획 승인(변경승인) 신청서에 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서류를 첨부하여 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Application for Approval of Implementation Plan, etc.) ①An offshore wind power business operator who intends to obtain approval or approval for modification of an implementation plan pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment an application for approval (approval for modification) of an offshore wind power business implementation plan in the form of Annex 5, attaching documents classified according to each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 실시계획의 승인을 신청하려는 경우: 다음 각 목의 서류
rows.text_en: 1. In case of applying for approval of the implementation plan: the documents in each of the following subparagraphs

rows.source_ko: 가. 법 제25조제1항에 따른 실시계획서
rows.text_en: a. Implementation plan pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 나. 법 제26조제1항에 따른 환경성평가서
rows.text_en: B. Environmental assessment report pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 다. 법 제27조제1항 각 호의 인허가 등을 위하여 제출하는 서류
rows.text_en: C. Documents submitted for the approval, etc., under each subparagraph of Article 27, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 실시계획의 변경승인을 신청하려는 경우: 변경하려는 사항을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. In case of applying for approval of a change to the implementation plan: Documents proving the matters to be changed

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 기후에너지환경부장관은 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다) 및 지적도를 확인해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall verify the certificate of corporate registration (applicable only to corporations) and the cadastral map through the joint use of administrative information.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(환경성평가준비서 등) ① 영 제20조제1항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 환경성평가준비서”란 다음 각 호의 항목이 포함된 환경성평가준비서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Preparatory Report for Environmental Assessment, etc.) ① The term “preparatory report for environmental assessment prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 20 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree refers to a preparatory report for environmental assessment that includes the items of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 환경성평가 대상사업의 목적 및 개요
rows.text_en: 1. Purpose and Overview of Projects Subject to Environmental Assessment

rows.source_ko: 2. 환경성평가 대상지역 설정
rows.text_en: 2. Designation of Environmental Assessment Target Areas

rows.source_ko: 3. 토지이용계획안
rows.text_en: 3. Land Use Plan

rows.source_ko: 4. 환경성평가 대상사업이 실시되는 지역 및 그 주변지역에 대한 지역 개황
rows.text_en: 4. Regional Overview of the Area Where the Project Subject to Environmental Assessment is Implemented and Surrounding Areas

rows.source_ko: 5. 환경성평가의 평가 항목ㆍ범위ㆍ방법 등(이하 이 조에서 “평가항목등”이라 한다)의 설정 방안
rows.text_en: 5. Methods for establishing evaluation items, scope, methods, etc., of environmental impact assessment (hereinafter referred to as “evaluation items, etc.” in this Article)

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제20조제2항에 따른 환경성평가협의회(이하 이 조에서 “평가협의회”라 한다)의 위원장은 평가협의회의 회의를 소집하고, 그 의장이 된다.
rows.text_en: ② The chairperson of the Environmental Assessment Council pursuant to Article 20 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “Assessment Council”) shall convene meetings of the Assessment Council and serve as the chairperson thereof.

rows.source_ko: ③ 평가협의회의 위원장이 부득이한 사유로 직무를 수행할 수 없을 때에는 평가협의회의 위원장이 미리 지명한 평가협의회의 위원이 그 직무를 대행한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the Chairperson of the Evaluation Council is unable to perform their duties due to unavoidable circumstances, a member of the Evaluation Council designated in advance by the Chairperson shall perform the duties on their behalf.

rows.source_ko: ④ 평가협의회의 회의는 재적 위원 과반수의 출석으로 개의(開議)하고, 출석 위원 과반수의 찬성으로 의결한다.
rows.text_en: ④ Meetings of the Evaluation Council shall be opened with the attendance of a majority of the registered members and decisions shall be made by the approval of a majority of the members present.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 영 제21조제1항 전단에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 환경성평가서”란 다음 각 호의 항목이 포함된 환경성평가서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ In the first part of Article 21, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “environmental assessment report prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to an environmental assessment report that includes the items of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 요약문
rows.text_en: 1. Summary

rows.source_ko: 2. 환경성평가 대상사업의 개요
rows.text_en: 2. Overview of Projects Subject to Environmental Assessment

rows.source_ko: 3. 평가항목등의 결정 내용
rows.text_en: 3. Details of the determination of evaluation items, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 환경성평가 대상사업이 실시되는 지역 및 그 주변지역에 대한 지역 개황
rows.text_en: 4. Regional Overview of the Area Where the Project Subject to Environmental Assessment is Implemented and Surrounding Areas

rows.source_ko: 5. 평가 항목별 조사 내용(조사 내용에 따른 환경영향 예측 사항을 포함한다) 및 평가 결과
rows.text_en: 5. Investigation details by evaluation item (including environmental impact predictions based on the investigation details) and evaluation results

rows.source_ko: 6. 환경보전을 위한 조치
rows.text_en: 6. Measures for Environmental Conservation

rows.source_ko: 7. 불가피한 환경영향 및 이에 대한 대책
rows.text_en: 7. Inevitable Environmental Impacts and Countermeasures

rows.source_ko: 8. 환경영향에 대한 대안 설정 및 이에 대한 평가
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment of alternatives for environmental impact and evaluation thereof

rows.source_ko: 9. 종합평가 및 결론
rows.text_en: 9. Overall Evaluation and Conclusion

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제1항부터 제5항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 평가항목등의 구체적인 내용과 환경성평가서 작성 등에 필요한 사항은 기후에너지환경부장관과 해양수산부장관이 공동으로 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 5, specific details of evaluation items, etc. and matters necessary for the preparation of the environmental assessment report, etc. shall be jointly determined and announced by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries .

rows.source_ko: 제8조(개발사업의 착공 신고 등) ① 영 제23조제1항에 따라 개발사업을 착공하려는 해상풍력발전사업자는 별지 제6호서식의 개발사업 착공신고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Notification of Commencement of Development Project, etc.) ①An offshore wind power generation business operator who intends to commence a development project pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit a notification of commencement of development project in the form of Annex 6, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment.

rows.source_ko: 1. 공사계획서
rows.text_en: 1. Construction Plan

rows.source_ko: 2. 공사감리계약서 사본(해당 사항이 있는 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Copy of the construction supervision contract (limited to cases where applicable)

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제23조제2항에 따라 공사를 중지하려는 해상풍력발전사업자는 별지 제7호서식의 개발사업 공사 중지 신고서를 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② An offshore wind power business operator who intends to suspend construction pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit a report on the suspension of construction of a development project in the form of Annex 7 to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment.

rows.source_ko: 제9조(개발사업의 준공인가 신청 등) ① 영 제24조제1항에 따라 개발사업의 준공인가를 신청하려는 해상풍력발전사업자는 별지 제8호서식의 개발사업 준공인가 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Application for Approval of Completion of Development Project, etc.) ①An offshore wind power generation business operator who intends to apply for approval of completion of a development project pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment an application for approval of completion of a development project in the form of Annex 8 , attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 준공조서(준공설계도서 및 준공사진을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Completion Report (including completion design documents and completion photographs)

rows.source_ko: 2. 「전기사업법 시행규칙」 제34조에 따른 검사확인증(판정이 합격인 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Inspection confirmation certificate pursuant to Article 34 of the Enforcement Rules of the Electric Power Business Act (limited to cases where the judgment is pass)

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제24조제3항에 따라 준공인가 전 사용허가를 받으려는 해상풍력발전사업자는 별지 제9호서식의 개발사업 준공인가 전 사용허가 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② An offshore wind power business operator who intends to obtain a permit for use prior to completion approval pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment an application for a permit for use prior to completion approval of a development project in the form of Annex 9 , attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 사용하려는 발전시설 및 설비의 완성단계 도면 및 공정현황
rows.text_en: 1. Drawings of the completed stage and progress status of the power generation facilities and equipment to be used

rows.source_ko: 2. 사용하려는 발전시설 및 설비의 사용 가능 여부에 대한 공사감리자 의견서 또는 공사감독관의 의견서
rows.text_en: 2. Opinion statement from the construction supervisor or the construction inspector regarding the feasibility of using the power generation facilities and equipment to be used

rows.source_ko: 3. 「전기사업법 시행규칙」 제34조에 따른 검사확인증(판정이 합격인 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Inspection confirmation certificate pursuant to Article 34 of the Enforcement Rules of the Electric Power Business Act (limited to cases where the judgment is pass)

rows.source_ko: Article 10 (Installment Payment of Amounts to be Paid by Offshore Wind Power Business Operators) ①If an offshore wind power business operator intends to pay the amount payable in installments pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, they must submit an application for installment payment in the form of Annex No. 10 to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment within 30 days from the date of selection as an offshore wind power business operator, attaching documents proving the reason for the installment payment.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Installment Payment of Amounts to be Paid by Offshore Wind Power Business Operators) ①If an offshore wind power business operator intends to pay the amount payable in installments pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, they must submit an application for installment payment in the form of Annex No. 10 to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment within 30 days from the date of selection as an offshore wind power business operator, attaching documents proving the reason for the installment payment.

rows.source_ko: ② The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall, within 10 days from the date of receiving the application under Paragraph 1, verify the payment ability, etc. of the offshore wind power business operator and notify whether installment payments are made.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall, within 10 days from the date of receiving the application under Paragraph 1, verify the payment ability, etc. of the offshore wind power business operator and notify whether installment payments are made.

rows.source_ko: ③ If the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment decides on installment payment pursuant to Paragraph 2, the offshore wind power business operator shall pay an amount equivalent to 30 percent of the costs payable before the date of the commencement of construction report pursuant to Article 30 , Paragraph 1 of the Act , and the remaining balance shall be paid in installments within four installments, provided that the final payment date is prior to the date of approval of completion pursuant to Article 31, Paragraph 2 of the Act .
rows.text_en: ③ If the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment decides on installment payment pursuant to Paragraph 2, the offshore wind power business operator shall pay an amount equivalent to 30 percent of the costs payable before the date of the commencement of construction report pursuant to Article 30 , Paragraph 1 of the Act , and the remaining balance shall be paid in installments within four installments, provided that the final payment date is prior to the date of approval of completion pursuant to Article 31, Paragraph 2 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: Article 11 (Application for Designation as a Specialized Research Institution) ①person who intends to be designated as a specialized research institution pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment an application for designation as a specialized research institution in the form of Annex No. 11 , attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Application for Designation as a Specialized Research Institution) ① A person who intends to be designated as a specialized research institution pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment an application for designation as a specialized research institution in the form of Annex No. 11, attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Current status of research personnel, facilities, and equipment for promoting research and development and commercialization of offshore wind power-related technologies
rows.text_en: 1. Current status of research personnel, facilities, and equipment for promoting research and development and commercialization of offshore wind power-related technologies

rows.source_ko: 2. Performance record regarding the promotion of research and development and commercialization of offshore wind power-related technologies
rows.text_en: 2. Performance record regarding the promotion of research and development and commercialization of offshore wind power-related technologies

rows.source_ko: 3. Plan for Promoting Research and Development and Commercialization of Offshore Wind Power Related Technologies
